scope: Substantive refresh of a 700 word post at its existing URL

observations.summary: Removed an unsourced '20 to 30 years' lifespan claim, an unsourced 'pump every three to five years' schedule, generic trust copy, a news article on groundwater testing used as the only source, and an image alt that repeated the title.
observations.inference_limit: No new service claimed; tank pumping is described as maintenance without implying Wade's provides it.

observations.summary: All water leaves through one main drainage pipe into the tank; solids settle as sludge, grease floats as scum; compartments and a T shaped outlet keep them in the tank; drainfield is a shallow covered excavation in unsaturated soil; soil accepts, treats and disperses wastewater.

Conventional systems pipe effluent to shallow gravel trenches; chamber systems use connected chambers; drip systems use a dose tank for timed delivery; mound systems pump to the mound in prescribed doses; sand filters pump effluent under low pressure; aerobic units inject oxygen and need ongoing maintenance.
observations.inference_limit: General national descriptions; local designs vary.

observations.summary: Household systems should be inspected by a professional at least every three years.
Hours, free quotes and flat-rate pricing restated; all linked services and posts exist.
observations.inference_limit: Only confirmed business facts are restated.
